entities.summary: Tysnesøya is an island in Tysnes Municipality in Vestland county, Norway. The 198-square-kilometre (76 sq mi) island makes up the vast majority of Tysnes Municipality. The highest point on the island is the 753-metre (2,470 ft) tall mountain Tysnessåto.
